definitions.explanation: A postage stamp issued to mark a special event, anniversary, or notable person. Collected by philatelists and sometimes sold at a premium.

examples.japanese: {記念切手|きねんきって}を{買|か}いに{郵便局|ゆうびんきょく}へ{行|い}った。
examples.english: I went to the post office to buy commemorative stamps.

examples.japanese: オリンピックの{記念切手|きねんきって}が{発売|はつばい}された。
examples.english: Olympic commemorative stamps have been released.

examples.japanese: {祖父|そふ}は{何十年|なんじゅうねん}もかけて{集|あつ}めた{記念切手|きねんきって}のコレクションを{大切|たいせつ}にしている。
examples.english: My grandfather treasures his collection of commemorative stamps that he spent decades assembling.

notes:
USAGE:
Japan Post regularly issues {記念切手|きねんきって} for cultural events, famous people, and national milestones. They are popular collectibles.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {記念切手|きねんきって}を{集|あつ}める (to collect commemorative stamps)
- {記念切手|きねんきって}を{発行|はっこう}する (to issue commemorative stamps)
- {限定|げんてい}{記念切手|きねんきって} (limited-edition commemorative stamp)

RELATED WORDS:
- {普通切手|ふつうきって}: regular stamp
- {切手|きって}: stamp (general)
